Fixes and improvements for T-Deck, T-Pager and Cardputer:

- Fix valid saved messages sometimes showing “Message could not be read”.
- Keep conversation loading responsive and chat previews up to date.
- Remove the permanent conversation toolbar and restore the centered empty state.
- Improve route discovery and retries when a direct LoRa path stops working.
- Reject overheard packets addressed to another relay without blocking later delivery.
- Restore radio reception before slow storage work and improve clock synchronization handling.

Cardputer support remains beta and requires a Cap LoRa-1262 with an antenna.

Factory ZIP installs erase settings, identity and internal message history. Back up anything you want to keep before installing.
